metadata.title: CrIA Treino — AI-powered personalized workouts
metadata.description: Create personalized workouts with artificial intelligence from each student's measurements, limitations and goals. Review, swap exercises and export to PDF.

common.name: Name
common.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
common.disclaimer: Notice: this plan is an AI-generated suggestion and does not replace an assessment by healthcare or fitness professionals. If you feel pain, stop and seek a professional.

hero.title: Personalized workouts generated with artificial intelligence
hero.subtitle: Collect body measurements, limitations, goals and available days for each student. The AI suggests the workout, you review it with a checklist, swap what doesn't fit and export to PDF or send it straight to the student.

features.title: Everything in a single flow
features.subtitle: From the assessment form to the final PDF in minutes.

interview.title: Full assessment
interview.description: Body measurements, limitations, goals, weekly frequency, session length and available equipment.

ai.title: AI suggestion
ai.description: The AI builds a coherent workout based on the athlete's profile, respecting days, duration and restrictions.

review.title: Checklist review
review.description: Mark the exercises the student can't keep and instantly swap them for equivalent alternatives.

export.title: Export and share
export.description: Finish and send the workout to the student user with one click, or generate a professional PDF.

step1.title: 1. Set up the profile
step1.description: Enter measurements, goal, limitations and how many days per week the student trains.

step2.title: 2. Generate with AI
step2.description: The AI suggests a workout split with sets, reps and rest.

step3.title: 3. Review and swap
step3.description: Use the checklist to replace unfeasible exercises with equivalents for the same muscle group.

step4.title: 4. Export
step4.description: Send it to the student or download the PDF and start training.
